name: com.unity.visualscripting
description:
Visual scripting is a workflow that uses visual, node-based graphs to design behaviors rather than write lines of C# script.

Enabling artists, designers and programmers alike, visual scripting can be used to design final logic, quickly create prototypes, iterate on gameplay and create custom nodes to help streamline collaboration.

Visual scripting is compatible with third-party APIs, including most packages, assets and custom libraries.

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Compiled member units and ParameterValue object registry (Mono/IL2CPP).

### Changed
- ForEach, Flow/GraphPointer/EventBus, member units, and static reflection invoker hot paths.

See CHANGELOG.enhanced.md for full fork release notes (based on Unity 1.9.11).
